name: desktop-examples-compatibility
goal: Desktop Examples keeps documented examples and expandable verification coverage, with a type-safe evidence fixture.

steps.title: Identify the failing behavior, expected behavior, and reproduction.
steps.evidence: Approved Desktop scope is documented in the model-list feature specification: documentation plus expandable verification, with unchanged synthetic evidence semantics.

steps.title: Explain why existing standardized tests missed the bug; name the scenario, fixture, lifecycle or assertion gap and reusable test change.
steps.evidence: Strengthened the existing ui-evidence-review address scenario with closed/open verification, preserved usage gap and test-owned captures. Normal Desktop typecheck covers excessive addInitScript inference.

steps.title: Rerun the same unchanged regression test at a separate fix commit with loop record --phase green; preserve passing proof.
